# MedlinePlus

> > Trusted health information from the National Library of Medicine covering diseases, conditions, wellness, and medical resources for patients and families.

MedlinePlus is produced by the National Library of Medicine (NIH) and provides evidence-based health information from trusted sources including the National Institutes of Health, CDC, Mayo Clinic, and other leading medical institutions. The site covers comprehensive medical topics from diagnosis and treatment to patient safety and health literacy.

## Key Topics

- NIH and National Library of Medicine
- Diagnosis and testing
- Symptoms and treatment options
- Patient safety and health information
- Aging and older adult health
- Birth defects and fetal development
- Digestive health and gastrointestinal disorders
- Neurological disorders (NINDS)
- Heart and blood disorders (NHLBI)
- Mental health (NIMH)
- ClinicalTrials.gov resources
- CDC and disease prevention
- HIPAA and patient rights
- Complementary and integrative medicine

## Major Diseases and Conditions

- [Alzheimer's Disease | AD | MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/alzheimersdisease.html): Alzheimer's disease symptoms, diagnosis, and caregiving for dementia
- [Post-COVID Conditions (Long COVID): MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/postcovidconditionslongcovid.html): Long COVID symptoms, diagnosis, treatments after SARS-CoV-2 infection
- [Mood Disorders: MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/mooddisorders.html): Depression, bipolar disorder, and mental health treatments from NIMH
- [Irritable Bowel Syndrome | IBS | MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/irritablebowelsyndrome.html): IBS symptoms, causes, and treatments from NIH and digestive health experts
- [Huntington's Disease | HD | MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/huntingtonsdisease.html): Huntington's disease genetic testing and nerve degeneration from NINDS
- [Meniere's Disease | Meniere's Disease Symptoms | MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/menieresdisease.html): Inner ear disorder causing vertigo, tinnitus, hearing loss from NIDCD

## Blood and Cardiovascular Health

- [Bone Marrow Disease | Bone Marrow | MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/bonemarrowdiseases.html): Bone marrow diseases affecting blood cell production, from leukemia to anemia
- [Thrombocytopenia | Platelet Disorders | MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/plateletdisorders.html): Platelet disorders affecting blood clotting from NHLBI
- [Cardiac Rehabilitation | MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/cardiacrehabilitation.html): Heart attack and surgery recovery programs from NHLBI and AHA

## Pregnancy, Fetal Health, and Birth Defects

- [Fetal Health and Development: MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/fetalhealthanddevelopment.html): Fetal development, prenatal care, and testing across trimesters
- [Fetal Alcohol Spectrum Disorders: MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/fetalalcoholspectrumdisorders.html): FASD risks, diagnosis, and treatments from prenatal alcohol exposure

## Aging and Life Stage Health

- [Older Adult Health: MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/olderadulthealth.html): Healthy aging and geriatric care from Mayo Clinic and AGS Foundation

## Infectious Diseases and Substance Use

- [Syphilis | STD | Syphilis Symptoms | MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/syphilis.html): Syphilis STD testing, prevention, and antibiotic treatment from CDC
- [Methamphetamine: MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/methamphetamine.html): Meth addiction signs and health effects from NIDA

## Specialized Medical Topics

- [Complementary and Integrative Medicine: MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/complementaryandintegrativemedicine.html): Alternative medicine treatments and patient safety from NCCIH
- [Personal Health Issues: MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/personalhealthissues.html): Patient rights, HIPAA, advance directives, and health literacy resources
- [Skin Pigmentation Disorders | Hyperpigmentation | MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/skinpigmentationdisorders.html): Melanin disorders including vitiligo, albinism, and hyperpigmentation
- [Coma | MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/coma.html): Coma, unconsciousness, and brain injury states from NINDS
- [Color Blindness |  MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/colorblindness.html): Color vision defects and genetic conditions from National Eye Institute

## Reference and Directories

- [Organizations by topic beginning with W: MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/organizations/orgbytopic_w.html): Directory of health organizations for topics starting with W
